skills.description: Provides comprehensive guidance for executing image-to-video (图生视频) generation via the dreamina CLI for 即梦. Use when the user has reference images or media files and wants to generate video via CLI; mentions \"dreamina image2video\", \"图生视频CLI\", \"frames2video\", \"multiframe2video\", \"multimodal2video\"; or provides media files and asks to animate or synthesize them. This skill covers mode detection with a decision tree, parameter name differences between sub-commands, input limits per mode, and 4 mode-specific execution workflows. Always use this skill when the user wants to generate video from reference media via the dreamina command line.
